methodology.Volume: Value swapped in Curve pools, counting one side of each trade. Deposits and withdrawals are not counted as volume.

methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees distributed to LPs post protocol fee collection
methodology.Volume: Swap volume, excluding wash trading: pools whose daily trades come from too few distinct addresses to be organic, unless every pool token is a core asset or CoinGecko-listed.

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by traders only. External bribes are deposited by third parties to influence votes, so they are excluded here even though they count towards Fees.
methodology.Fees: Per-pool swap fee read from PoolFactory.getFee (default vAMM 0.30% / sAMM 0.05%, customizable per pool) applied to each swap, plus external bribes deposited by third parties to voter-incentive contracts.
methodology.Revenue: Swap fees earned by liquidity staked in gauges and bribes, paid to veVELO voters, plus the staked-liquidity fees locked in the gauges since their last fee distribution ahead of the Aero upgrade (2026-10-15 on Optimism and Ink, earlier on the other chains).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Swap fees earned by liquidity staked in gauges since their last fee distribution ahead of the Aero upgrade, locked in the gauges until the Aero Foundation reclaims them. Zero before.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Swap fees earned by liquidity staked in gauges until the gauges last distributed fees ahead of the Aero upgrade (2026-10-15 on Optimism and Ink, earlier on the other chains), plus bribes until voting ended on 2026-10-22, all paid to veVELO voters.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Swap fees kept by unstaked LPs (fee × (1 − stakedShare)). LPs who stake in the gauge forgo these fees in exchange for VELO emissions.
methodology.Volume: Swap volume across Velodrome v2 (non-CL) pools, counted once per swap from the core-asset side.

methodology.Fees: Total swap fees paid by users.
methodology.Revenue: The share of swap fees earned by liquidity staked in a gauge, plus the rake taken from unstaked liquidity: paid to veVELO voters until the gauges last distributed fees ahead of the Aero upgrade (2026-10-15 on Optimism and Ink, earlier on the other chains), locked in the gauges after that.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The same share of swap fees since the gauges last distributed fees ahead of the Aero upgrade, locked in the gauges until the Aero Foundation reclaims them. Zero before.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The share of swap fees that went to veVELO voters until the gauges last distributed fees ahead of the Aero upgrade (2026-10-15 on Optimism and Ink, earlier on the other chains): everything earned by liquidity staked in a gauge, plus the rake taken from unstaked liquidity.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The share of swap fees kept by liquidity providers who have not staked their position in a gauge, after the rake.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Total swap fees paid by users.

Revenue.Staked-LP Fees Locked In Deactivated Gau: The same fees since the gauges last distributed fees, locked in the gauges until the Aero Foundation reclaims them.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To Voters: Fees earned by gauge-staked liquidity plus the rake on unstaked liquidity, both claimable by voters until the gauges last distributed fees ahead of the Aero upgrade.

ProtocolRevenue.Staked-LP Fees Locked In Deactivated Gau: Fees earned by gauge-staked liquidity plus the rake on unstaked liquidity since the gauges last distributed fees, locked in the gauges until the Aero Foundation reclaims them.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Unstaked LPs: Fees earned by liquidity that is not staked in a gauge, net of the rake, which stays with the position owner.

methodology.Volume: Darkpool volume: source-side token amounts of TAKER orders matched inside Tristero against a filler with no external venue calls, plus MARGIN opens and the loan settlement leg of margin closes. Counted once, on the source leg the taker sells - the filler's side of the fill is the same trade settling, not a second trade. Orders where the taker is also the filler are excluded, being circular rather than traded with a third party. Orders routed through external venues are aggregation flow and are reported on the Tristero Aggregator adapter instead.

Revenue.Nado Builder Fees To Otomate: All builder fees accrue to Otomate.
Revenue.Tydro Performance Fees To Otomate: The vault's on-chain performance fee on lending interest; fee withdrawals are not counted again.

ProtocolRevenue.Nado Builder Fees To Otomate: All builder fees accrue to Otomate.
ProtocolRevenue.Tydro Performance Fees To Otomate: Performance fees reserved for the vault owner, Otomate.

SupplySideRevenue.Tydro Yield To Depositors: Lending interest less the vault's on-chain performance fee.
